name: Pyrena
source:
After his new life in the big city doesn't quite go to plan, Junior Bird finds himself back in his home town, surrounded by old faces.

When his past shows up to haunt him, and people in town start going missing, Bird will have to decide whether the past is something he should be holding onto in the first place.

[From [url=https://aderie.itch.io/pyrena]Itch.io[/url]]
